entry.content:
Alors. 

This "blog" (or whatever you want to call it) is entirely dedicated to my opinion.

That’s right. MY opinion.

I don't hold back. No corporate political correctness here. I will speak my mind, regardless of who it makes uncomfortable. Now, don't worry. I'm not here writing some digital communist or socialist manifesto. Politics isn't the star of this show.

I’m taking my EYE 🧿 to profile people (and normal civilians too). I will sit down with them and ask observational NON-boring questions instead of basic PR ones. 

Oh and I’ll also be dumping my notebook entries here. I'm planning on writing micro-essays on the design behind IKEA’s winding paths, consumerism, CAN Ibiza, the disappearance of newsstands on Toronto sidewalks, hotel concierges (Mr. Gustave my icon), Oasi Zegna, Hermès Horizon’s Alex Beaufort... all of it.

Plus I’m an HBSc candidate so I'm also thinking of translating and dumping down info I read in dense research papers on the gut microbiome into stuff you can actually read without falling asleep.

I know this sounds all over the place. I'll get better at writing don't worry lol.

Consider this your masterclass on how to become a true GAZELLE DE WALLER. Pure taste and high cultural capital.

Read along. Or don't, habibi.
